issue.title: collectAll drops the items on the final page
issue.body:
`collectAll` in src/paginate.js loses the items on the final page. It pushes the current page's items only while `hasMore` is true, so when the fetcher reports the last page the loop exits without ever appending it.

`node --test test/paginate.test.js` fails on "collects every page, including the last": with three pages of one item each it returns two items instead of three.

Expected: every page's items are returned, including the last.
